arxiv-1503-06866.title: Study of all the periods of a Neuronal Recurrence Equation
arxiv-1503-06866.creator: Serge Alain Ebélé, René Ndoundam
arxiv-1503-06866.description: Abstract We characterize the structure of the periods of a neuronal recurrence equation. Firstly, we give a characterization of k-chains in 0-1 periodic sequences. Secondly, we characterize the periods of all cycles of some neuronal recurrence equation. Thirdly, we explain how these results can be used to deduce the existence of the generalized period-halving bifurcation. Keywords.

arxiv-1912-10522.title: Acoustic versus electromagnetic field theory: scalar, vector, spinor representations and the emergence of acoustic spin
arxiv-1912-10522.creator: Justin Dressel
arxiv-1912-10522.description: Abstract We construct a novel Lagrangian representation of acoustic field theory that describes the local vector properties of longitudinal (curl-free) acoustic fields. In particular, this approach accounts for the recently-discovered nonzero spin angular momentum density in inhomogeneous sound fields in fluids or gases.

arxiv-2012-00004.title: UWB at SemEval-2020 Task 1: Lexical Semantic Change Detection
arxiv-2012-00004.creator: Ondřej Pražák, Pavel Přibáň, Stephen Taylor, Jakub Sido
arxiv-2012-00004.description: Abstract In this paper, we describe our method for detection of lexical semantic change, i.e., word sense changes over time. We examine semantic differences between specific words in two corpora, chosen from different time periods, for English, German, Latin, and Swedish. Our method was created for the SemEval 2020 Task 1: Unsupervised Lexical Semantic Change Detection.

arxiv-2108-06262.title: Contrasting Third-Party Package Management User Experience
arxiv-2108-06262.creator: Syful Islam, Raula Gaikovina Kula, Christoph Treude † , Bodin Chinthanet, Takashi Ishio, Kenichi Matsumoto
arxiv-2108-06262.description: Abstract The management of third-party package dependencies is crucial to most technology stacks, with package managers acting as brokers to ensure that a verified package is correctly installed, configured, or removed from an application. Diversity in technology stacks has led to dozens of package ecosystems with their own management features.

arxiv-2208-04278.title: Self-Supervised Contrastive Representation Learning for 3D Mesh Segmentation
arxiv-2208-04278.creator: Ayaan Haque, Hankyu Moon, Heng Hao, Sima Didari, Jae Oh Woo, Patrick Bangert
arxiv-2208-04278.description: Abstract 3D deep learning is a growing field of interest due to the vast amount of information stored in 3D formats. Triangular meshes are an efficient representation for irregular, non-uniform 3D objects. However, meshes are often challenging to annotate due to their high geometrical complexity. Specifically, creating segmentation masks for meshes is tedious and time-consuming.

arxiv-2212-05966.title: Comparison between Docker and Kubernetes based Edge Architectures for Enabling Remote Model Predictive Control for Aerial Robots
arxiv-2212-05966.creator: Achilleas Santi Seisa, Sumeet Gajanan Satpute, George Nikolakopoulos
arxiv-2212-05966.description: Abstract Edge computing is becoming more and more popular among researchers who seek to take advantage of the edge resources and the minimal time delays, in order to run their robotic applications more efficiently. Recently, many edge architectures have been proposed, each of them having their advantages and disadvantages, depending on each application.

arxiv-2308-05629.title: ReLU and Addition-based Gated RNN
arxiv-2308-05629.creator: Rickard Brännvall, Fredrik Sandin
arxiv-2308-05629.description: Abstract We replace the multiplication and sigmoid function of the conventional recurrent gate with addition and ReLU activation. This mechanism is designed to maintain long-term memory for sequence processing but at a reduced computational cost, thereby opening up for more efficient execution or larger models on restricted hardware.

arxiv-2407-00468.title: MMEvalPro : Calibrating Multimodal Benchmarks Towards Trustworthy and Efficient Evaluation
arxiv-2407-00468.creator: Jinsheng Huang *, Liang Chen *, Taian Guo, Fu Zeng, Yusheng Zhao, Bohan Wu, Ye Yuan, Haozhe Zhao, Zhihui Guo, Yichi Zhang, Jingyang Yuan, Wei Ju, Luchen Liu, Tianyu Liu, Baobao Chang †, Ming Zhang †
arxiv-2407-00468.description: Abstract Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) exhibit impressive cross-modal understanding and reasoning abilities, often assessed through multiple-choice questions (MCQs) that include an image, a question, and several options. However, many benchmarks used for such evaluations suffer from systematic biases. Remarkably, Large Language Models (LLMs) without any visual perception capabilities achieve non-trivial performance, undermining the credibility of these evaluations.

arxiv-2410-13121.title: Trust but Verify: Programmatic VLM Evaluation in the Wild
arxiv-2410-13121.creator: Viraj Prabhu, Senthil Purushwalkam, An Yan, Caiming Xiong & Ran Xu
arxiv-2410-13121.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Viraj Prabhu, Senthil Purushwalkam, An Yan, Caiming Xiong & Ran Xu. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) often generate plausible but incorrect responses to visual queries. However, reliably quantifying the effect of such hallucinations in free-form responses to open-ended queries is challenging as it requires visually verifying each claim within the response. We propose Pro grammatic V LM E valuation ( PROVE ), a new benchmarking paradigm for evaluating VLM responses to open-ended queries.

arxiv-2412-18676.title: Bicycle tracks with hyperbolic monodromy – results and conjectures
arxiv-2412-18676.creator: G. Bor, L. Hernández-Lamoneda, S. Tabachnikov
arxiv-2412-18676.description: Abstract We find new necessary and sufficient conditions for the bicycling monodromy of a closed plane curve to be hyperbolic. Our main tool is the “hyperbolic development” interpretation of the bicycling monodromy of plane curves. Based on computer experiments, we pose two conjectures concerning the bicycling monodromy of strictly convex closed plane curves.

arxiv-2504-13592.title: Improving Generalization in Intent Detection: GRPO with Reward-Based Curriculum Sampling
arxiv-2504-13592.creator: Zihao Feng, Xiaoxue Wang, Ziwei Bai, Donghang Su, Bowen Wu, Qun Yu, Baoxun Wang
arxiv-2504-13592.description: Abstract Intent detection, a critical component in task-oriented dialogue (TOD) systems, faces significant challenges in adapting to the rapid influx of integrable tools with complex interrelationships. Existing approaches, such as zero-shot reformulations and LLM-based dynamic recognition, struggle with performance degradation when encountering unseen intents, leading to erroneous task routing.

arxiv-2506-19673.title: The Asai–Flach Euler system in p p -adic families Thanks: Both authors gratefully acknowledge financial support from the European Research Council under the European Union’s Horizon 2020 research and innovation programme (Grant agreement No. 101001051 — Shimura varieties and the Birch–Swinnerton-Dye
arxiv-2506-19673.creator: David Loeffler, Arshay Sheth
arxiv-2506-19673.description: Abstract . We show that the Euler system for the Asai representation corresponding to a Hilbert modular eigenform over a real quadratic field, constructed by Lei, Loeffler and Zerbes (2018), can be interpolated p p -adically as the Hilbert modular form varies in a Hida family.

arxiv-2602-20533.title: Asymptotic geometric regularity of CAT(0) spaces Thanks: Partially supported by JSPS KAKENHI Grant Numbers 20K03603, 25K06996
arxiv-2602-20533.creator: Koichi Nagano
arxiv-2602-20533.description: Abstract . We prove that if an n n -dimensional geodesically complete CAT ⁡ ( 0 ) \operatorname{CAT}(0) space has Tits boundary sufficiently close to the ( n − 1 ) (n-1) -dimensional standard unit sphere, then it is bi-Lipschiz homeomorphic to the n n -dimensional Euclidean space.

openalex-w2136326608.description: Background: On two farms it was noted that after routine treatment with monepantel, fecal egg counts failed to drop. This was accompanied by lambs mortality due to Haemonchus contortus infection. The aim of this work was to evaluate the efficacy of monepantel to control...

pmc-10736614.title: IMPLICATIONS OF THE COVID-19 PANDEMIC ON ADULT DAY SERVICES
pmc-10736614.creator: Katherine Marx, Lauren Parker, Laura Gitlin
pmc-10736614.description: Covid-19 hit Adult Day Services (ADS) hard with sites across the country forced to close. As part of the ADS-Plus study, two focus groups were conducted to understand the impact of Covid-19 on ADS sites, their participants, and staff. Six sites across the country, represented by nine staff and administration (females=n, males=1) participated in focus groups.

pmc-11397070.title: Prevalence of undiagnosed hypertension and associated factors in Ndera sector, Gasabo district of Rwanda: a cross-sectional study
pmc-11397070.creator: Akeem Ayodeji Okesina, Jean Claude Habineza, Richard Mbazumutima, Umurerwa Mignonne, Celine Mahirwe, Samuel Hakizimana, Mojeed Akorede Gbadamosi, Aashna Uppal, Francis Paul Wabwire
pmc-11397070.description: BackgroundHypertension remains a major global health challenge, including in low- and middle-income countries. In Rwanda, a lack of adequate information and healthcare services impacts healthcare-seeking behaviors, contributing to undiagnosed hypertension in rural areas. Therefore, the need to determine its prevalence and associated factors.

pmc-11421045.title: Associations between single nucleotide polymorphisms of cytokines and hepatitis B virus‐related liver cirrhosis: A case‐control study
pmc-11421045.creator: Yijun Li, Haowei Zhou, Weikang Wu, Wenhua Zhang, Yancheng Ye, Wenling Jia, Chunhui Liang, Haitao Tang, Fengmei Wang, Zhongjun Shao, Xiaojie Yuan, Weilu Zhang
pmc-11421045.description: Background and AimsVarious inflammatory and immune cytokines play key roles in the progression of hepatitis B virus (HBV)‐related liver cirrhosis (LC). This study explored the relationship between single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) in cytokines with the combined effect of polymorphisms and gender‐polymorphisms interaction and LC risk.

pmc-11631297.title: Coronary microvascular dysfunction and left heart filling pressures in patients with type 2 diabetes
pmc-11631297.creator: Emil Wolsk, Mikkel Jürgens, Morten Schou, Mads Ersbøll, Philip Hasbak, Andreas Kjaer, Bo Zerahn, Niels Høgh Brandt, Peter Haulund Gæde, Peter Rossing, Jens Faber, Caroline Michaela Kistorp, Finn Gustafsson
pmc-11631297.description: AimsPatients with type 2 diabetes (T2D) have a high prevalence of diastolic dysfunction and heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF), which in turn leads to an increased risk of hospitalization and death. However, the factors of risk and their relative importance in leading to higher left ventricular filling pressures are still disputed.

pmc-12602227.title: Is radioiodine necessary for patients with low-risk differentiated thyroid cancer after thyroidectomy: a pooled analysis of ESTIMABL2 and IoN trials
pmc-12602227.creator: Chuansheng Yang, Deping Luo, Jian Xie, Yingting Zou, Fei Chen, Wenchun Yang, Linfeng Zeng, Jing Liu
pmc-12602227.description: BackgroundThe clinical utility of postoperative radioiodine therapy in patients with low-risk differentiated thyroid cancer (DTC) remains a subject of ongoing debate. Although radioiodine has been widely employed to reduce the risk of recurrence, its necessity in low-risk populations is increasingly questioned, given the favorable outcomes observed with surgery alone.

pmc-12967582.title: Measurement of Acute Intraocular Pressure Elevation Immediately After Intravitreal Anti-VEGF Injection and Analysis of Prefilled Syringe Accuracy
pmc-12967582.creator: Kaku Itoh, Misaki Negishi
pmc-12967582.description: PurposeTo compare and evaluate, across different agents, the risk of intraocular pressure (IOP) elevation after anti-VEGF therapy and the accuracy of prefilled syringes.MethodsTotal of 175 eyes treated with anti-VEGF drugs were enrolled for this study. An accuracy evaluation of the prefilled syringes was conducted involving 25 participants, comprising 17 physicians and 8 nurses.

pmc-13281551.title: Assessment of parental awareness of diabetic ketoacidosis in children with diabetes: a cross-sectional study at a tertiary referral center in Iran
pmc-13281551.creator: Homa Ilkhanipoor, Nima Hosseini, Hamide Barzegar, Hossein Moravej, Leila Salarian
pmc-13281551.description: BackgroundDiabetic ketoacidosis (DKA) is a life-threatening complication of type 1 diabetes (T1DM) and a leading cause of pediatric mortality. Prevention depends on caregivers’ ability to recognize early signs and initiate proper sick-day management. However, data on DKA awareness among Iranian parents remains limited.

pmc-13672672.title: DNMT1 is associated with QDPR downregulation and chemotherapy response in lung adenocarcinoma
pmc-13672672.creator: Lyubo Wang, Guicai Liang, Lei Zhu, Zurui Liu, Yuxian Dong, Kun Wang, Hong Yao, Chunlei Ge, Lincan Duan
pmc-13672672.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). In lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD), DNA methylation-mediated gene silencing may contribute to tumor initiation, progression, and heterogeneity in treatment response. However, the key methyltransferases involved and their therapeutic potential have not been systematically characterized. This study aimed to address three major questions: which methylation-associated gene silencing events occur in LUAD, which upstream methyltransferase predominantly drives these events, and whether targeted inhibition of this enzyme can mitigate drug-resistant phenotypes and enhance chemosensitivity.
